description: Search the FULL IEEE Xplore corpus — IEEE and IET journal articles, conference proceedings, magazines, books, courses and standards — returning title, authors, abstract, publication venue, year, DOI and the IEEE Xplore link. The broad engineering / computer-science research tool: IEEE paper search, engineering research paper lookup, conference proceedings search, literature review on a technical topic, tracking one author's IEEE publications. Set content_type to focus on a single kind of record ("Conferences", "Journals", "Standards", "Magazines", "Books", "Courses", "Early Access"), or omit it to search every type at once. Returns metadata plus the abstract; the full text is sold by IEEE, so follow html_url to purchase or read it under an institutional subscription. Requires your own free IEEE Xplore API key via _apiKey (register an app at developer.ieee.org). Example: ieee_search({ query: "federated learning edge devices", limit: 10, _apiKey: "your-ieee-key" }). Example: ieee_search({ query: "millimeter wave beamforming", content_type: "Conferences", year: 2024, _apiKey: "your-ieee-key" })

_apiKey.description: Your IEEE Xplore Metadata API key, sent as the `apikey` query param. Free — register an app at https://developer.ieee.org.

author.description: Restrict to an author name, e.g. "Yoshua Bengio" (optional).

content_type.description: Restrict to one IEEE content type (optional). Omit to search every content type at once.

index_terms.description: Restrict to an IEEE or author index term, e.g. "Deep learning" (optional).

publication_title.description: Restrict to a journal or proceedings title, e.g. "IEEE Transactions on Antennas and Propagation" (optional).

query.description: Free-text search across IEEE metadata (title, abstract, index terms), e.g. "federated learning edge devices", "lithium-ion battery state of charge estimation".

sort_order.description: Sort direction (default desc when sorting by publication_year, asc otherwise).

start_record.description: 1-based offset for paging through a large result set (default 1).

year.description: Restrict to this publication year, e.g. 2024 (optional).

name: ieee_search
title: Ieee Search
